//: bom1 is Mumbai, the same AWS region as this project's Supabase database
(aws-1-ap-south-1). Vercel was defaulting to sin1 (Singapore), so every
database connection crossed the Bay of Bengal and back.
That matters far more than it sounds because the serverless engine uses
NullPool: a connection is opened per request rather than reused. Measured
from sin1 that cost ~3.2s, and a request needing two of them took ~7s while
the dashboard took ~19s. The function itself was only ~700ms of that.
If the database is ever moved, move this with it.
